name: nku26-wiki
description: NKU-China 2026 Wiki (NemaKlear): Astro and Tina, interactive homepage, model chapters, scroll-opened pages and day/night reading.

scripts.build: node tools/export-tina.mjs && astro build && node tools/restore-original-images.mjs && node tools/finalize-stage-assets.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.prebuild: node tools/prepare-viewers.mjs && node tools/apply-cdn-fonts.mjs && node tools/prepare-nemaklear.mjs
scripts.test:deployment: node --test tools/tests/assets.test.mjs tools/tests/author-format.test.mjs tools/tests/dbtl-content.test.mjs tools/tests/scene-loading.test.mjs tools/tests/scene-framing.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.test:homepage: node --test tools/tests/field-camera.test.mjs tools/tests/opening-fallback.test.mjs tools/tests/glass-refraction.test.mjs tools/tests/story-wheel.test.mjs tools/tests/home-discovery-input.test.mjs tools/tests/home-gesture-gate.test.mjs
